title: Opening Hours
text: Enamel Dental is open Monday to Friday from 9:00 to 18:00 and Saturday from 9:00 to 14:00. The clinic is closed on Sundays and public holidays. Please arrive ten minutes before your appointment so the front desk can complete the check-in.

title: Insurance and Direct Billing
text: We accept most major dental insurance plans. Bring your insurance card and a photo ID to your first visit. Participating insurers are billed directly; for other plans you pay at the desk and we issue a itemised receipt for reimbursement within fourteen days.

title: Emergency Care
text: For urgent dental pain call the clinic directly. Same-day emergency slots are held open each morning at 9:00 and each afternoon at 14:00. Outside opening hours the voicemail message gives the on-call number for urgent advice.

title: Cancellation and No-show Policy
text: Cancel or reschedule at least 24 hours before the appointment. A late cancellation or a missed appointment may incur a 500 INR fee. Repeated no-shows may require prepayment for future bookings.

title: Payment Plans
text: Interest-free instalments are available for treatments above 25,000 INR, over three or six months, subject to approval at the front desk. A 20 percent deposit is required before treatment starts and the remaining balance is split across the agreed months.

title: Parking and Access
text: Two visitor parking spaces are available behind the building. Street parking is free after 18:00. The nearby market car park charges 40 INR per hour. The entrance is step-free and the lift reaches the first-floor surgery.

title: Sedation Dentistry
text: Nitrous oxide and oral sedation are available for anxious patients. A responsible adult must accompany you and take you home. Do not drive, cycle or operate machinery for six hours after sedation, and do not eat for two hours before oral sedation.

title: Children's Dentistry
text: Children are welcome from their first tooth or by their first birthday. The first visit is a lap examination with the parent present. Fluoride varnish is applied every six months, and fissure sealants are offered for newly erupted molars.

title: Infection Control
text: Instruments are cleaned and sterilised in a class B autoclave, needles are single-use, and spore testing is performed weekly. Every instrument pack carries a traceability label that is recorded in the patient file.

title: Radiography Safety
text: We use digital radiographs at the lowest diagnostic dose, with a lead apron and thyroid collar. A panoramic radiograph is usually repeated every three to five years unless a clinical indication requires it. Tell the clinician if you are or may be pregnant before any image is taken.

title: Dental Implants
text: Implants are placed in two stages: a titanium fixture is placed into the jaw, then a crown is fitted after healing, usually three to six months later. Planning uses a CBCT scan. Long-term follow-up and good oral hygiene are required.

title: Orthodontics and Aligners
text: Clear aligners and fixed braces are both available. Treatment starts with a digital scan and a written plan. Aligners are worn 20 to 22 hours a day and replaced every one to two weeks; a retainer is worn after treatment to hold the result.

title: Tooth Whitening
text: In-chair whitening takes about 60 minutes. Sensitivity for up to 48 hours is common, and you should avoid tea, coffee, red wine and smoking for 24 hours. Whitening is not recommended during pregnancy or while breastfeeding.

title: After an Extraction
text: Bite on the gauze for 30 minutes, do not rinse for 24 hours, and use an ice pack for swelling. Eat soft food and avoid straws. If bleeding continues beyond two hours, call the clinic.

title: Records and Privacy
text: Clinical records are confidential. A copy is released only with written consent from the patient, or where the law requires it. Portal access uses a one-time code sent to the registered contact, and the code is never shared with anyone else.

title: Your First Appointment
text: The first visit includes a full examination, radiographs if clinically needed, and a written treatment plan. Allow about 45 minutes. Bring photo ID and your insurance details so the front desk can verify cover before you leave.
